title: Reported Speech: Pronouns and Possessives — Quiz 127
content:
## Reported Speech: Pronouns and Possessives

Choose pronouns and possessive adjectives to match the speaker and listener.

### Lesson focus

1. The teacher said, “Raj, you are one of my best students.”
2. My friends and I said, “We should plant trees.”
3. Our new teacher said, “Dear children, you are the author of your own destinies.”

### Practise with the image

Read the full lesson image for the original exercise, notes and any answer key shown. Write your own answers before checking a key. A key labelled for another quiz belongs to that quiz.
